safety.act_anaphylaxis: Anaphylaxis risk. Traveler carries an EpiPen: {epipen}. Before departure find out who has it and where; keep it in the cabin, not the trunk; check food and snack ingredients.
safety.act_asthma: Asthma: ask them to keep an inhaler in the cabin. Dirt roads are dusty — keep windows closed.
safety.act_cardio: Heart or blood pressure: avoid long climbs in the heat, rest in the shade, know where the nearest medical point is.
safety.act_drug_allergy: Drug allergy: during evacuation be sure to tell the medics — the traveler knows the details.
safety.act_gluten: Gluten-free: no bread, flatbread or baursaks.
safety.act_halal: Halal: make sure the meat is halal.
safety.act_lactose: Lactose-free: no dairy, including ayran and kurt.
safety.act_motion_sickness: Motion sickness: seat them in front, stop regularly on dirt roads, keep water and bags at hand.
safety.act_no_trad_dairy: Do not offer kumys, shubat or kurt without the guest's clear consent.
safety.act_nuts: Nut allergy: check sweets and pastries.
safety.act_seafood: Seafood allergy: ask whether fish is safe for them.
safety.act_vegan: Vegans: no meat, dairy or eggs — agree the menu in advance.
safety.act_vegetarian: Vegetarians: agree the menu in advance.

safety.privacy: Only the assigned guide sees them after the booking is confirmed. Health details are deleted {days} days after the tour.
safety.season_autumn: Autumn: karakurts stay active until the end of September. Nights are cold — warm clothes for the group.
safety.season_spring: Spring: snakes come out of hibernation. Of the 8 snake species in Mangystau only the Halys pit viper is venomous — watch your step near rocks. Check clothes for ticks.
safety.season_summer: Summer: heat and peak karakurt season (July–September). Shake out shoes, keep tents closed, set up camp in daylight. Find out in advance where antivenom is available: in 2026 some hospitals ran short.
safety.season_winter: Winter: strong wind, frost and short days — start early, carry extra fuel and warm clothes.
safety.title: Group safety
